dict.string: Takes a photo or short video to send in Messages, and lets a site you're on use your camera when you agree. Totality keeps nothing you don't send.
Lets a site you're on see your location when you agree. Totality doesn't keep it.
Records sound for a short video you send in Messages, and lets a site you're on use your microphone when you agree. Totality keeps nothing you don't send.
Saves an image from a page to your photos when you choose to.
Shows the calendars on this device next to your Totality events. Totality doesn't copy or upload them.
